subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should the compact Control UI progress strip be implemented only after the canonical `sessions.activity` contract is accepted, or should maintainers allow a narrower UI-first slice over existing signals?
rationale: The request crosses Control UI presentation and public gateway/session-state semantics, and the current open PRs do not yet settle the API, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, or proof questions.

options.title: Settle the gateway activity contract first
options.body: Use #39127 and a refreshed implementation candidate such as #96672 or a replacement to define the activity/attention source of truth, then build the compact UI strip on that contract.

options.title: Permit a narrow UI-first slice
options.body: Allow a small status strip over existing coarse signals while explicitly deferring attention, child-rollup, stale-run, and reconnect semantics to #39127.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until maintainers are ready to own the broader session activity API and UI semantics.

recommendation.title: Settle the gateway activity contract first
recommendation.body: Use #39127 and a refreshed implementation candidate such as #96672 or a replacement to define the activity/attention source of truth, then build the compact UI strip on that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the live canonical activity-contract issue and has recent gateway/protocol-adjacent history for the affected API surface.
